text:
incident-bot: Pager event for service 'runtime-inference' — primary (Alice H) has not acknowledged for 12m. Escalation to secondary in 3m. Link: https://pager.example/INC-4521

Alice H: I'm in a meeting, just saw this. On my way out in ~5m. Sorry, missed the ack.

Ben P: I can take primary for the next 8h if that helps. can someone hand me the pager?

Carly R: @Ben P :thumbsup: Ben, are you local? Do you have access to the dedicated cluster? Need to confirm quick access to logs and the runbook.

Ben P: Yep I'm local. kubectl and vpn are up. I pulled the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-latency

Dan S: Quick checklist for handoff — (1) transfer pager in PD, (2) update rotation spreadsheet, (3) add note in #oncall-log. I'll do the spreadsheet update if you confirm, Ben.

Alice H: Ben, please take it. I'm handing off now. Steps I did: muted meeting, leaving a short note in /oncall-log, started runbook step 0-inspect.

oncall-coordinator-bot: Action: Pager transfer initiated by Alice H -> Ben P. Command: `pdcli transfer --incident INC-4521 --from alice.h --to ben_p`

Ben P: Got the transfer notification. Acked the pager. Taking primary. Running initial checks: cpu/ram on inference-nodes, error rates, latency p50/p95.

Carly R: If latency spike, runbook suggests checking KV-cache metrics and fallback routing: section 'latency-fallback' in runbook.

Ben P: Copy. First quick check: p95 elevated on eu-west-1 batchers. `kubectl -n inference get pods | grep batcher` shows 3/3 running but CPU at 90%.

Dan S: If CPU saturation, try scale-up annotation: `kubectl annotate deployment batcher --overwrite scale-target=+2` then run autoscaler check. Put the command in #eng-runtime when you do it.

Ben P: Will do; holding off 2m to confirm no regression from recent deploy. No canary alerts yet. If I scale, I'll notify.

Eva L: Also confirm dedupe cache TTL is not causing rebuild storms — see runbook snippet:
```
# check cache hits
curl -s http://cache-metrics/metrics | grep cache_hit_ratio
```

Ben P: Thanks Eva. ran cache hit check — 0.82 hit ratio, ok. Proceeding with scale annotation now.

oncall-coordinator-bot: Transfer complete. Rotation spreadsheet updated by Dan S. Primary is Ben P for 2024-04-05 00:30 UTC -> +8h. Secondary remains Alice H. Note added: 'short meeting handoff - manual takeover'.

Alice H: Thanks team — I'm available as secondary and will stay reachable. Leaving a short runbook pointer in the thread.

Ben P: All set, scaling applied, p95 dropping back toward baseline. I'll keep watch. If anything pops, I'll escalate to Dan.

Carly R: :coffee: nice. Ben, add a short postmortem note in #oncall-log if we cross 15m above threshold.

Ben P: Will do. Closing thread for this handoff — monitoring.
